From fe4f002eefc45f44126a18a73c71d14789fff890 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lucas Denefle <lucas.denefle@converge.io>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2024 14:28:29 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] modem: modem_cellular: increase model_id size

Fixes an issue introduced with `08a51bae`

Signed-off-by: Lucas Denefle <lucas.denefle@converge.io>

diff --git a/drivers/modem/modem_cellular.c b/drivers/modem/modem_cellular.c
index 96250df392d..728c4dec6ec 100644
--- a/drivers/modem/modem_cellular.c
+++ b/drivers/modem/modem_cellular.c
@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@ LOG_MODULE_REGISTER(modem_cellular, CONFIG_MODEM_LOG_LEVEL);
 	K_MSEC(CONFIG_MODEM_CELLULAR_PERIODIC_SCRIPT_MS)
 
 #define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_IMEI_LEN         (15)
-#define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN     (64)
+#define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN     (65)
 #define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_IMSI_LEN         (22)
 #define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_ICCID_LEN        (22)
 #define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MANUFACTURER_LEN (65)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/modem/modem_cellular.c`**
   - The length of the `MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN` constant has been increased from 64 to 65. This change allows for a larger model ID size, which addresses a bug that was introduced in a previous commit (`08a51bae`).

### Relationships
- The modification in `modem_cellular.c` directly addresses a bug related to the size of the model ID, which was likely causing issues in the handling or storage of model IDs. The change is a corrective measure to ensure that the model ID can accommodate the necessary data, thus improving the functionality of the modem cellular driver.

Here is the commit message:
modem: modem_cellular: increase model_id size

Fixes an issue introduced with `08a51bae`

Signed-off-by: Lucas Denefle <lucas.denefle@converge.io>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the insufficient size of the `MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN` constant, which was set to 64. This limitation likely led to buffer overflows or truncation issues when handling model IDs that exceeded this length, resulting in incorrect data processing or application crashes.

-#define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN     (64)
+#define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN     (65)
 #define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_IMSI_LEN         (22)
 #define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_ICCID_LEN        (22)

Reason:
The constant `MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN` was set to 64, which was insufficient for handling model IDs that exceeded this length. This limitation likely caused buffer overflows or truncation issues, leading to incorrect data processing or application crashes.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
#define MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN     (65)
```
Reason:
By increasing the size of `MODEM_CELLULAR_DATA_MODEL_ID_LEN` from 64 to 65, the patch allows for the proper handling of model IDs that may be up to 65 characters long, thus preventing buffer overflows and ensuring correct data processing.
